title: Let Me Not to the Marriage of True Minds

concepts.learning_objective: Explain what the speaker means by refusing to admit impediments to the marriage of true minds.
Interpret the claim that love which changes when circumstances change is not true love.

topics.title: The ever-fixed mark and the guiding star (lines 5-8)

concepts.learning_objective: Interpret the image of love as an ever-fixed mark that looks on tempests unshaken.
Explain the metaphor of love as the star that guides every wandering ship (bark).
Explain how the poem shows love as independent of Time and physical beauty.
Interpret the image of Time's bending sickle and the special meaning of 'compass'.

topics.title: The closing couplet, the sonnet form and the poet
topics.ncert_sections: Lines 13-14; About the Poet; Try This Out

concepts.learning_objective: Interpret how the closing couplet stakes the poet's writing on the truth of his claim.
Identify the features of the Shakespearean sonnet and the poem's use of negatives.
Recall key facts about William Shakespeare and Sonnet 116.
